apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.5 — Two fixes. (1) LoopLab Edit navigation: the library stack's path was typed to songs only, so the swara editor's push had nowhere to go and the stack fell back to the list; the path is now type-erased and the editor push lands. (2) Waveform visibility: the scroll gate's hosted stack no longer paints an opaque background over the waveform.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
